scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm --filter @dtg/db migrate && pnpm -r --parallel dev
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: pnpm 10 blocks dependency lifecycle scripts by default (ADR-0005). Allowed: esbuild (postinstall sets up its platform binary) and @swc/core (postinstall verifies the native binding and installs the @swc/wasm fallback on unsupported platforms) — both load-bearing for the API build and the component-api test tier. Reviewed and left disabled: cpu-features / ssh2 (native perf optionals for an ssh transport we don't use), protobufjs (CLI shim), msw (service-worker file copy; we use the Node setupServer).
